title: The Paper Clock
author: Juniper Nakamura
blurb: Jonah Ishikawa, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
